disclaimer: Hypothetical simulation on a synthetic market. No money is invested, the prices are not real, and these results are not a forecast or financial advice. Taxes, inflation and interest on uninvested cash are not included.

assumptions.title: Round-ups
assumptions.text: Each purchase is rounded up to the next whole dollar; the spare change is set aside.

assumptions.title: Whole-dollar purchases
assumptions.text: A purchase of an exact dollar amount, like $4.00, adds nothing.

assumptions.title: What counts as a purchase
assumptions.text: Card payments, transfers, cash withdrawals, fees and refunds never create round-ups. You can reclassify any row.

assumptions.title: When money is invested
assumptions.text: Saved-up round-ups are bought at the closing price of the next trading day after they are ready, never at a price from before the purchase.

assumptions.title: Starting setting for timing
assumptions.text: Round-ups start out set to be invested once they add up to $5.00. Investing after every purchase day, weekly or monthly are equally valid to explore.

assumptions.title: Prices
assumptions.text: Purchases use each simulated day's closing price from the scenario, never adjusted afterwards.

assumptions.title: Dividends
assumptions.text: Dividends are reinvested on the day they are paid, unless you turn this off. Until then they count at face value.

assumptions.title: Fractional shares
assumptions.text: Small amounts buy part of a share, so every cent is invested.

assumptions.title: Running costs
assumptions.text: Treated as already included in the scenario's prices, as a real fund's costs would be, so nothing more is subtracted.

assumptions.title: Costs not included
assumptions.text: Trading costs, app subscription fees and account fees are not included. Real apps may charge fees that matter a lot for small balances.

assumptions.title: One possible path
assumptions.text: A made-up scenario shows one possible path, not what any market will do.

assumptions.title: Synthetic scenarios
assumptions.text: Synthetic scenario. Not a real fund, not real prices, and not a forecast. Scenarios are generated by a published, seeded model.
